title: AgentShield event envelope
description: Every event on every topic carries this envelope. Java and Python both validate against this file, so a change here is a change to both sides by construction.

eventId.description: Idempotency key. Generated once when the event is created and never regenerated on retry - an id minted at publish time would defeat consumer deduplication entirely.

eventVersion.description: Payload shape version. A consumer that sees a version above the one it was built for must dead-letter the message rather than guess: a misread security event is a wrong verdict.

aggregateId.description: The scan id. Also the Kafka partition key, so all events about one scan are ordered.

correlationId.description: Threads one trace from the API call through Kafka to the engine and back.

payload.description: Event-specific body. Additive changes do not require a version bump; removing or retyping a field does.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context of the span that produced this event. Optional: a consumer that receives none starts a fresh trace rather than dropping the message.

$comment: Payloads must never contain target credentials, authentication headers, raw secrets, or unredacted personal data. The engine redacts before publishing; see agentshield.redaction.
